functions.description: Computes and returns the sum of two integers. Intended for straightforward integer addition; no side effects or state interaction are indicated. Typical usage: pass two int values and use the returned int as the result. No error reporting is specified.
requirements: Parameters a and b must be valid int values.
If the mathematical sum of a and b does not fit in the range of a signed int, behavior is undefined per C rules for signed integer overflow.
Caller should handle the returned value as the sum; no error codes or errno usage are specified.
Function has C linkage; usable from C and C++ (within extern "C").
